additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Dakroury,
I am reaching as I took over ticket
ID0474952.
Thank you for your patience and apologies for the late feedback.
As I understood, the charger is now running on FW v4.0.11 and you would like to update it to our latest FW version (v8). This means 4 consecutives FW rollout and updates (v4 > v5 > v6 > v7 > v8).
Since this morning I tried to manually rollout the subsequent FW version v5.0.23, but unfortunately I am experiencing some very slow upload speed. The connection to the charger also got interrupted several times, slowing down even more the process.
In this situation, it results very complicated and long to update the charger remotely.
I will discuss this topic on Monday with Mr. Alyousuf, as I see him not in office today. We will discuss the way forward and if a local onsite update could be the way forward to speed up the process.
Thank you again for your patience, I will provide you with feedback as soon as possible.
Have a nice weekend.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0474952-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2/SD314005673001] Update Readiness CRM:03056000991
additional_info.body:
Dear Mohamed,
I am following up our conversation for this charger. As we discussed, due to the very poor quality connection onsite, we need to organize an onsite visit to Flash the CFast card and update in one shot the charger from v4.0.11 to v8.1.4.
To do so, the following steps are required:
Preparation in office:
Have a laptop with Companion Tool installed
Download the FW v8.1.4 from companion tool
Required free space on the disk is 90GB
Onsite activity:
Bring the laptop with companion
Bring 1 or more ETH cables
Bring the CFast card reader
Connect the CFast card from the charger to the laptop via CFast card reader
Flash the CFast card via Companion
Re-commission the charger by inserting newly flashed CFast card
Verify configuration of the charger from SCB
I forecast the activity to take around 30 mins for the download of the FW on the laptop, 30 mins/1 hour to flash the CFast card and around 1/1.5 hour to recommission the charger.
We can plan a remote session according to my availability, so that I can guide the technician through each step.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
